approvalScope.description: Approval with conditions for WEOS-OD-023 Stage 1 repository-native governed-command contracts, schemas, pure command-contract and token-policy registries, validation, stale-state resolution, idempotency, batch-policy and eligibility infrastructure. Dependency evidence: WEOS-AUTH-APP-003. Supporting foundation: WEOS-AUTH-APP-002.

approverAuthority: Founding Architecture Authority bootstrap authority for initial WEOS governance foundation only
rationale: WEOS requires explicit expected-state preconditions for governed mutation commands so stale state cannot be overwritten by authority, route access, idempotency or retries. This record approves WEOS-OD-023 with conditions for Stage 1 repository-native contracts only, using WEOS-AUTH-APP-003 as dependency evidence and WEOS-AUTH-APP-002 as supporting foundation evidence.
conditions: every governed command declares an approved concurrency contract
revisioned canonical artifacts use exact expected revision identifiers
expected version and opaque-token use is policy-defined
authority and expected-state checks are independent
stale commands fail closed without mutation or Governance Decision
governed batches are atomic by default
idempotency does not bypass concurrency or authority
duplicate retries cannot produce duplicate effects
stale commands are not silently rebased
safe conflict metadata requires disclosure authorization
legacy concurrency history is not invented
no Prisma, persistence, runtime command integration or enforcement is authorized

bootstrapAuthority.scope: Initial WEOS governance foundation for repository-native governed-command documentation, APP-004 approval evidence, JSON schemas, TypeScript serializable contracts, pure in-memory command-contract registry, pure in-memory token-policy registry, validation, precondition comparison, idempotency resolution, batch-policy evaluation, eligibility resolution, deterministic conformance tests and documentation integration only. This does not grant Prisma, persistence, database compare-and-swap, transactions, DTOs, controllers, guards, services, command handlers, projection synchronization, audit persistence, token issuing, runtime idempotency storage, production command declarations, production token policies, deployment or runtime enforcement authority.
bootstrapAuthority.expiryCondition: Expires when a permanent governed-command runtime enforcement process approved under WEOS-OD-023 or an approved successor becomes effective.
